facts.text: Product liability is a manufacturer's legal duty to compensate people harmed by a defective product.
facts.quote: Product liability is the legal duty of a manufacturer to compensate people harmed by a defective product

facts.text: The European Union's new Product Liability Directive explicitly extends product liability to software and makes it easier for claimants to obtain manufacturers' internal evidence.
facts.quote: the European Union's new Product Liability Directive extends that duty explicitly to software and makes it easier for claimants to obtain the manufacturer's internal evidence.

facts.text: Directive (EU) 2024/2853 applies to products placed on the market after 9 December 2026.
facts.quote: Directive (EU) 2024/2853 applies to products placed on the market after 9 December 2026.

facts.text: Under Directive (EU) 2024/2853, software, including updates, is a product.
facts.quote: Software, including updates, is a product.

facts.text: Under the product liability rules described in the booklet, courts may order manufacturers to disclose evidence; a defect is presumed if the manufacturer fails to disclose or technical complexity makes proof excessively difficult for the claimant.
facts.quote: Courts may order the manufacturer to disclose evidence, and a defect is presumed if the manufacturer fails to disclose, or where technical complexity makes proof excessively difficult for the claimant

facts.text: Software updates within the manufacturer's control remain within the manufacturer's product liability.
facts.quote: Updates within the manufacturer's control stay within its liability

facts.text: The booklet's product liability reviewer states that simulation has no legal safe harbor; the contemporaneous record must distinguish reducing physical testing because virtual evidence was demonstrated credible from reducing testing because the schedule required it.
facts.quote: There is no legal safe harbor for simulation; what will matter is whether the contemporaneous record shows that physical testing was reduced because virtual evidence had been demonstrated credible, or because the schedule required it.

facts.text: The booklet's product liability reviewer recommends writing the safety case as if an opposing expert will read it and including the simulation's validity limits.
facts.quote: write the safety case as if an opposing expert will read it; include the validity limits of the simulation

facts.text: The booklet's product liability reviewer recommends preserving all raw data and model versions and retaining event data.
facts.quote: preserve all raw data and model versions; enforce the operating domain technically and log it; retain event data

facts.text: The booklet's product liability reviewer recommends technically enforcing the operating domain and logging it.
facts.quote: enforce the operating domain technically and log it

facts.text: The booklet's product liability reviewer recommends obtaining written brake-interface approvals from the machine manufacturer, because a mining company flagged integration without those approvals as a liability risk in 2015.
facts.quote: obtain written approvals for brake interfaces from the machine manufacturer, since integrating without them was flagged as a liability risk by a mining company in 2015

facts.text: The booklet's product liability reviewer cites an on-road United States jury verdict dated 1 August 2025 that found a carmaker one-third responsible and awarded about $243 million, including $200 million in punitive damages; the theories included failure to restrict the system to its intended domain.
facts.quote: a United States jury verdict of 1 August 2025 (on-road) that found a carmaker one-third responsible and awarded about 243 million dollars, including 200 million in punitive damages, on theories that included failing to restrict the system to its intended domain

facts.text: The booklet's product liability reviewer concludes that legal sign-off at the end is too late because the evidence architecture itself has legal implications.
facts.quote: Legal sign-off at the end is too late, because the evidence architecture itself has legal implications

facts.text: If the main markets are outside the European Union, the booklet's product liability reviewer says United States, Australian and South African rules take the foreground.
facts.quote: if the main markets are outside the EU, the United States, Australian and South African rules take the foreground

facts.text: The assumptions and gaps in a disclosed simulation safety case become the claimant's exhibit.
facts.quote: The assumptions and gaps of a disclosed simulation safety case become the claimant's exhibit

facts.text: A liability review that rejects the safety case is a named failure mode for the booklet's program.
facts.quote: a liability review that rejects the safety case is one of the booklet's named failure modes
